steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F); lightly grease a 23 x 33 cm baking dish with olive oil.
Peel and dice 1 onion; mince 2 garlic cloves; dice 1 red bell pepper into small pieces.
Heat 30 ml of olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and red bell pepper; cook for 4 minutes, until slightly softened.
Add 300 g of ground turkey and the minced garlic; cook for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking up the meat, until no pink remains.
Stir in 30 g of tomato paste, 400 g of crushed tomatoes, 2 g of oregano, and 2 g of cumin.
Add 400 g of cooked white beans; stir well and season with 1 g of salt.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish; bake for 15 minutes, until bubbling at the edges.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving over rice or with bread.
Yield: 4 family portions. Refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze up to 1 month.
